1
Hindu Ki Bakhshish
Mehshar Mein Di Farishton Ne Dawar Ko Yeh Khabar.
Hindu Hai Aik Ahmad-e-Mursal Ka Madah Gar.
Hai Bot Parast Agarche Woh Lekin Hai Naat Go.
Ahmad Ki Naat Likhta Hai Dunya Mein Beshtar.
Hai Naam Dilo Raam Takhalus Hai Kausri.
Le Jaein Oss Ko Khuld Mein Ya Janib-e-Saqar.
Sunte Hi Yeh Malaikah Se Ik Anokhi Baat.
Farmaya Zuljalal Ne Janat Hai Oss Ka Ghar.
ALLAH Akbar Ahmad-e-Mursal Ka Yeh Lehaz.
Ki Haq Ne Lutf Ki Sag-e-Dunya Peh Bhi Nazar.

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script for [Hindu Ki Bakhshish](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/ef638035d4714689a19e9a24858413a7/src/data/lyrics/hindu-ki-bakhshish-tajpoints-af32d73f0ca1fe8ec4d8.md) and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified line-by-line alignment, retained the opening title line in both versions, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`.

I rendered the Roman name and takhallus “Dilo Raam” and “Kausri” as دلو رام and کوثری.
